blacklistabilityReview.evidence: On 2026-07-30 the access posture was re-derived across the canonical and bridged deployments. At Ethereum block 25648350 the USN proxy 0xdA67B4284609d2d48e5d10cfAc411572727dc1eD still resolves to implementation 0x6bdc8104ec827cd48b9cac526420b59a31bc8397, whose Sourcify-verified source (contracts/USNUpgradeableHyperlane.sol) exposes onlyOwner blacklistAccount(address) and unblacklistAccount(address) over a public blacklist mapping and reverts transfers with BlacklistedAddress whenever blacklist[from] || blacklist[to]. owner() returned the Noon 3-of-6 admin Safe 0x1ea169EcCcf7714E7ba04900e1a3357cCA77327f, so the live signer set can blacklist any holder immediately; the 48-hour timelock covers only proxy upgrades, not the blacklist function. The same token codebase runs on the bridged representations: the zkSync Era warp 0x0469d9d1de0ee58fa1153ef00836b9bbcb84c0b6 exposes the blacklist(address) view and its blacklistAccount reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount for unauthorized callers, and the Sophon warp 0xc1aa99c3881b26901af70738a7c217dc32536d36 exposes the blacklist view and reverts OwnableUnauthorizedAccount (probes at zkSync Era block 71379660 and Sophon block 29616847); the Starknet representation is owner-administered under the 2026-07-20 bridge-route review. Direct holder-level freeze reach is therefore a current live fact, so the posture is reviewed true (individual reach), superseding the 2026-07-14 possible.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USN is natively issued on Ethereum through MinterHandlerV2. Its zkSync, Sophon, and Starknet deployments are burn-mint bridge representations: Hyperlane warp/router paths cover those tracked routes, while LayerZero Endpoint V2 peers are live between Ethereum and zkSync/Sophon only. The official TAC registry also identifies the USN representation 0x51a30e647d33a044967fa3dbb04d6ed6f45455f6 on TAC, but tac is not registered in shared/lib/chains/index.ts and is intentionally omitted from the catalog contract and route inventory. Its TAC block 24352134 owner Safe 0x868dd9bce1d60362f2169e7b91e6aa2f71f64750, token implementation 0x01a660f4b4f87b8b42ba6f02c63c38c87af610c2, proxy admin 0xf4059d5f0b70f828ed2f087b43e91351203b2bbe, Hyperlane mailbox 0x3a464f746d23ab22155710f44db16dca53e0775e, mailbox owner 0xb801c2712f92e2d29e1120862e0f9c93d80cbbca, and default ISM 0xad3bce653f56d4e03d0789d01d055b06cf6ac48f remain named Bridge Risk evidence gaps pending chain admission. Current tracked-route token owners, proxy slots, mailbox owners, default ISMs, Hyperlane remote mappings, and LayerZero peer reads are recorded below; Hyperlane validator sets and LayerZero DVN/message-library/executor configuration remain unresolved, so the external-validated-network tier is provisional.

controls.evidence: starknet_call at blocks 13501913–13502090: Mailbox.owner matches the authored controller. That account returns get_name=ArgentMultisig, threshold 4, seven signer public keys, class 0x6e150953.... Default ISM aggregation children, Pausable unpaused, and Ethereum-origin 6-of-9 validators were read from the live contracts. This is not a Gnosis Safe; signer values are Stark public keys, so no Safe API/threshold object is asserted.
